prompts.clean: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: ONE square seamless game PBR BASECOLOR source scan, not a rendered scene. Orthographic directly overhead photographic scan showing TWO METRES by TWO METRES of dense fine-aggregate urban asphalt. This is densely compacted bitumen with small embedded 1–4 mm mineral particles, predominantly tiny dark grains; almost no grains wider than two or three image pixels. Asphalt must read as a quiet dense charcoal plane from standing distance, with believable fine granular detail up close, never loose gravel, cobblestones, pebbles, popcorn or big shiny stones. Neutral cool charcoal grey approximate unlit sRGB #4b4d4d. Cross-polarized perfectly even diffuse illumination with NO shadows, light direction, highlights, wet reflections, vignette, perspective, edge border or labels. Continuous road material fills every pixel. All four edges must wrap seamlessly and remain quiet consistent asphalt with no structural joint/seam. No painted road lines, arrows, kerbs, manholes, litter, objects, tyre-tread graphic or human. Exactly one opaque square image, ideally 2048 by 2048. No montage, no map-channel grid. CONDITION: clean fine dense asphalt, maintained dry surface, no notable stain, no visible cracks or patch repair. Slight natural binder/aggregate variation and a few darker embedded grains, very restrained local tone differences. Do not add grunge or harsh all-over white speckles.
